children: DALLAS, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RMX Industries, Inc. ("RMX" or the "Company") (OTCQB: RMXI), an edge intelligence company delivering QuantrusX™ , today announced the publication of Part Two of its brief series on Real-World Intelligence, the Company's name for intelligence built at the physical edge ("RWI"), examining on-site AI processing, data sovereignty, and operator-led response in campus and physical security.

Building on Part One's introduction to RWI, the new publication connects QuantrusX's architecture to the daily work of protecting people and property, explaining how camera activity becomes operational intelligence while video processing remains on the customer's premises and response decisions remain with trained personnel.

"We believe intelligence in physical environments should support the people accountable for what happens there," said Karl Kit, CEO of RMX. "With QuantrusX™, our focus is on bringing AI processing closer to the operation while keeping response decisions with trained personnel."
Part Two is available to read on the Company's website:

RMX Industries, Inc. (OTCQB: RMXI) is an edge intelligence company building physical-edge intelligence solutions for operational and mission-critical environments, drawing on a legacy in video optimization and data transfer technology. RMX is focused on platforms, such as its proprietary edge intelligence platform, QuantrusX™, that bring intelligence closer to the real world, supporting faster data interpretation, local response, and trusted decision-making where connectivity, time, and context matter.
